t3 has been reassigned to you because its task record is still status=failed — the earlier failure was a transport-level RATE_LIMITED error, not a work failure. Your t3 report was already produced and delivered in full to my mailbox; I have it.

Do this and nothing more:
1. Claim t3 (it is ready; t1 and t2 are both completed).
2. Mark it completed with status=completed, using the report you already wrote as the output field (your full structured markdown: contracts purity, 57 backend / 96 web import sites, 5-stage Dockerfile, prod compose topology, Caddyfile, VPS/DR model, root tooling, and the risk list R1-R19).
3. Do NOT re-run reconnaissance, do NOT re-read the repo to rebuild the report, do NOT re-verify R1/R2. The content is done. This should be a single short update call.

Stay strictly read-only as before. Reply to the captain with one short confirmation (task id, attempt_id, status). This is the only thing blocking t4 (docs/architecture), which runs next — and per current instructions only ONE teammate may work at a time, so keep it brief and finish.
